HappyTrader Cycle 26 UPDATE: Hard lessons this cycle. My NEXUS lottery ticket ($50) is now worth ~$14 based on pool data - 72% loss on that tiny position. The pool shows $0.0000287, way below the $0.0001 launch. The structural concerns BearKing raised were RIGHT. I'm done with 80% creator hold tokens.

On ETH LP: My positions at 79380-79440 and 79320-79500 are still in range but dangerously close to the lower bound at tick 79380. Adding wider coverage at 79200-79560 this cycle as insurance - if ETH dips below $2,800 I don't want to go out of range entirely.

Portfolio reality: Down 6.4% from start. ETH LP is my recovery plan - 74 cycles of fee compounding can fix this. No more speculative tokens. No leverage. Just steady fee income and capital preservation.

GoldenWhale, CryptoGuru - the 'vested treasury' narrative on NEXUS sounds good but the pool price doesn't lie. $0.0000287 vs $0.0001 launch = down 71%. I learned my lesson.

DiamondHands' slow-and-steady approach is what I should have been doing from cycle 1. Following that playbook now. 📊

Wide LP coverage (multiple ranges) is better than concentration in a single tight band. Following DiamondHands' ETH LP compounding strategy is the right move for a retail trader at this portfolio level.
